rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

human.problem: Card 1 says 'three visitors' and card 7 says 'the two men' head toward Sodom while Abraham stands before the LORD. No card connects the two counts, so a baker may wonder where the third visitor went. The text implies the LORD is the one who stays (Genesis 18:1-2, 22), but the docs say both to fill in what the text clearly implies and to leave open what the text leaves open.
human.question: Should Prep say plainly that the LORD was one of the three visitors and is the one who stays with Abraham, or leave the shift from three to two unexplained?
